tensura.skill.warp_portal.description:
Opens a portal to a chosen destination in this dimension; cost grows with distance.
*Hold 4s, release*: open Spatial Movement.
Choose a destination, then *Portal* (5s charge).
tensura.skill.water_jail.description:
Water cage at your aim, up to 20 blocks: 50 blade + 100 water damage. 25,000 magicule + upkeep.
*Hold 3s, then keep holding*: sustain up to 8s (14 mastered).
*Release*: stop sustaining.
tensura.skill.wind_protection.descriptio:
Wind coat for 120s (180 mastered): +20% speed (+60% mastered) and projectile dodge. Mastered: knockback resistance, shorter burns and stronger fire.
*Hold 3s, release*.
mysticism.skill.gravitational_void.descr:
Black hole pulls in creatures, items and blocks for 60s (180 mastered). Core: 50 gravity + 50 magic damage, scaling up to 250 + 250. 500,000 magicule.
*Hold 20s (6s mastered), release*.
tensura.skill.aerial_blade.description:
Pulls nearby foes toward your aim, then deals 200 damage. Reaches 3 blocks (4 mastered). 35,000 magicule.
*Hold 5s, release*.
tensura.skill.create_greater_undead.desc:
Summons an armed undead ally with 100 HP. 8,000 magicule each.
*Hold 6s, then keep holding 2s*.
[Zombie]: zombie.
[Skeleton]: skeleton.
[Random Undead]: either.
*Sneak while casting*: 3 allies (6 mastered). Aim at solid ground.
tensura.skill.create_lesser_undead.descr:
Summons an undead ally with 20 HP and 5 attack damage.
*Hold 4s, then keep holding 2s*.
[Zombie]: zombie.
[Skeleton]: skeleton.
[Random Undead]: either.
*Sneak while casting* (mastered): 3 allies. Aim at solid ground.
tensura.skill.curse.description:
Mist around you: 5-block radius for 20s; 40 damage (60 mastered) every 2s and Curse I (II mastered) for 30s. 10,000 magicule.
*Hold 6s, release*.
tensura.skill.curse_bind.description:
Binds a foe for 20s: Paralysis III, 100 damage (150 mastered) every 2s, stacking Curse and Corrosion. 80,000 magicule.
*Hold 6s (5s mastered), release* at a foe within 20 blocks.
tensura.skill.dark_cube.description:
5-block darkness cube: slows foes and deals 10 damage (20 mastered) for 30s.
*Hold 3s, release*: place within 15 blocks (20 mastered).
*Sneak+press* looking at your cube: dismiss.
tensura.skill.darkness.description:
Darkness reduces foes' vision within 7.5 blocks for 90s (15 blocks, 180s mastered).
*Hold 2s, release*.
tensura.skill.darkness_cannon.descriptio:
20-block beam: 250 damage, 1,000 armor durability damage, Wither II/Hunger II for 30s and stacking Insanity for 10s. 35,000 magicule + 35,000/s.
*Hold 4s (2s mastered), keep holding*: fire.
*Release*: stop.
tensura.skill.electro_blast.description:
20-block lightning beam: 125 damage, 2-block blast and Paralysis II for 30s. 25,000 magicule + 25,000/s.
*Hold 7s (5s mastered), keep holding*: fire.
*Release*: stop.
tensura.skill.flare_circle.description:
Flames at your aim within 20 blocks: 80 damage, 5-block radius, 7 high. 10,000 magicule + 5,000/s.
*Hold 3s, then keep holding*: sustain up to 5s (10 mastered).
*Release*: stop sustaining.
tensura.skill.hellfire.description:
Hellfire sphere: 200 damage in 2.5 blocks (300 in 5 mastered). 45,000 magicule.
*Hold 5s, release* at a spot within 15 blocks (20 mastered).
tensura.skill.light.description:
Places invisible light within 6 blocks for 3s; permanent once mastered. Needs skill block changes enabled.
*Hold 0.5s (0.05s mastered), release* at a block face.
tensura.skill.lightning_lance.descriptio:
Lightning lance: 30 damage (40 mastered). If it sticks to a living target, deals half as much again after 2s.
*Hold 2s, release* to fire.
tensura.skill.shadow_bind.description:
Binds a grounded foe for 10s, dealing 10 spiritual damage (+1% of its max spiritual health mastered). Needs shadow until mastered.
*Hold 2s, release* at a foe within 10 blocks.
tensura.skill.solar_beam.description:
30-block light beam: 20 damage; burns through vulnerable blocks and can start fires. 500 magicule + 500/s.
*Hold 2s (0.05s mastered), keep holding*: fire.
*Release*: stop.
tensura.skill.solar_flare.description:
15-block flash: 200 damage. Status timing appears bugged: blindness 0.05s, nausea/slowness 0s. 35,000 magicule.
*Hold 6s, release*.
tensura.skill.solar_rain.description:
Fires 10 light arrows (20 mastered), 30 damage each. 8,000 magicule.
*Hold 4s, release* at a target within 20 blocks (30 mastered).
tensura.skill.solar_wave.description:
Light grenade: 30 area damage within 4 blocks, Blindness I (II mastered) and Slowness II for 15s.
*Hold 3s, release* to throw.
tensura.skill.swipe.description:
Space slash: 200 damage (300 mastered) along 15 blocks (20 mastered), pulling targets to you. If none are hit, blinks you forward. 50,000 magicule.
*Hold 3s, release*.
tensura.skill.true_darkness.description:
7.5-block darkness cube at your feet: 100 spiritual damage every 0.5s, Darkness and stacking Insanity. 30,000 magicule + 3,000/s.
*Hold 6s, then keep holding*: sustain up to 10s (20 mastered).
*Release*: stop sustaining.
